title: 聊天模型中拒绝行为位于人格下游
summary: 研究发现，在指令微调聊天模型中，拒绝行为与人格特质在激活空间中存在交互：顺从人格会门控拒绝。通过干预Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct中的方向，顺从人格引导可抑制拒绝（Llama中拒绝率从97%降至2%），而拒绝方向仅在后期层部分恢复拒绝。这表明拒绝行为在后期表达阶段被门控，位于其计算位置的下游。
summary_en: Research shows that refusal and persona traits interact in instruction-tuned chat models: a compliant persona gates refusal. Interventions on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct demonstrate that compliant persona steering suppresses refusal (from 97% to 2% in Llama), while refusal direction only partially restores it in late layers. Refusal is gated at the late-layer expression stage, downstream of computation.
